surface_mechanism_description: The nitrogen atoms in the thin films almost certainly originate from the ammonia, through transamination reactions between ammonia and the dimethylamido ligands in W2(NMe2)6. The ALD process involving W2(NMe2)6 and ammonia affords an ALD window between 180 and 210 uC. The growth is surface-limited and self-limiting, with surface saturative growth achieved with W2(NMe2)6 pulse lengths of 2.0 s.
